content.value: Suppose that a data warehouse for ‘Big University' consists of the following four dimensions: student, course, semester and instructor; and two measures count and ávg\_grade. When at the lowest conceptual level (e.g., fora given student, course, semester and instructor combination), the avg\_grade measure stores the actual course grade of the student. At higher conceptual levels, avg\_grade stores the average grade for the given combination.
i) Draw the snowflake schema for the data warehouse.

ii) Starting with the base cuboid [student, course, semester, instructor], what specific OLAP operations should one perform in order to list the average grade of CS courses for each ‘Big University' student.
iii)  If each dimension has five levels, such as “student < major < status < university < all", how many cuboids will this cube contain?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
